title: Spread Of Service Sector
definition: The multi-directional, spatial, and structural expansion of tertiary economic activities across various geographical tiers, urban-rural divides, and industrial sub-sectors in India, contributing over 54% to India's Gross Value Added (GVA).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (economic data, sub-sector classification, spatial trends) and Mains GS-3 (inclusive growth, employment elasticity, regional disparities, and digital infrastructure integration).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Spread Of Service Sector.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
